question: Should OpenClaw support configured deterministic/random acknowledgment choices, contextual rules, or a model-driven choice before processing?
rationale: The answer defines a new compatibility-sensitive cross-channel config and plugin SDK contract, and the alternatives have materially different latency, determinism, and channel-validity tradeoffs.

options.title: Configured Selector
options.body: Add an additive list or strategy while preserving strings and using channel-owned validation and fallback behavior.

options.title: Model-Selected Reaction
options.body: Add a pre-processing model decision hook and accept extra latency, nondeterminism, and a broader runtime contract.

options.title: Keep Singular Values
options.body: Retain predictable per-account, per-channel, and global acknowledgment strings without dynamic selection.

recommendation.title: Configured Selector
recommendation.body: Add an additive list or strategy while preserving strings and using channel-owned validation and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged per-channel resolution work is the clearest feature-history ownership signal for the contract being extended.
